# Paper 1: AlexNet (2012)

*ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks* · Module 1 — Optimization and depth · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#paper-1)

## Paper and resources
- [Paper](https://papers.nips.cc/paper_files/paper/2012/hash/c399862d3b9d6b76c8436e924a68c45b-Abstract.html)

## Walkthrough videos
- ▶ [AlexNet Paper Walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TWyp0_DEwCI)

## Study approach
Sections 3–4: non-saturating ReLU (6x faster than tanh), overlapping pooling, PCA color augmentation, dropout p=0.5.

## Interview hooks
"Why did depth + GPUs + regularization unlock representation learning?"

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND→AGENT** — Swap ReLU for tanh/sigmoid in a 5-layer CIFAR-10 CNN, plot per-layer `param.grad.norm()`.
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_swap_relu_for_tanh_sigmoid_in_a.ipynb`
2. **HAND→AGENT** — Remove dropout and weight decay, watch train acc hit 100% while val loss explodes.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_remove_dropout_and_weight_decay.ipynb`
